residual_risks: Startup-config logging (displayStartupConfig split into per-provider helpers) and the scheduler path (scheduleBackups/runScheduledJob) were verified only by line-by-line comparison against c77f548: log order, labels (including the 'Gitlab' LFS casing and the 'Organistations' typo) and the global `job` assignment are preserved. The only semantic delta is BitBucket compare using EqualFold instead of ToLower==, which is equivalent for ASCII env values.

checkProvidersDefined now computes bitbucketAPITokenComplete up front instead of inside the randomly-ordered map iteration; this removes a nondeterministic double count but cannot change the outcome because count is only compared to 0.
